excluded_from_unit_coverage.rationale: The Iced view layer, the application loop in lib.rs and the binary edge require a display server and are exercised by the end-to-end target instead of unit tests.

measurement_configuration.mechanism: cargo-llvm-cov 0.9.1 reads no configuration file of its own and accepts the exclusion only through the --ignore-filename-regex flag, so the exclusion is injected with the LLVM_COV_FLAGS environment variable, which cargo-llvm-cov forwards verbatim to llvm-cov export. Cargo's [env] configuration is applied only to build scripts, rustc, cargo run and cargo test, never to external subcommands, so the variable cannot be carried by .cargo/config.toml.
measurement_configuration.report_contents: coverage/lcov.info carries only src/core/** and src/platform/** records
measurement_configuration.ci_note: The CI coverage stage wires the same scope explicitly into its cargo llvm-cov invocation and enforces the gate with --fail-under-lines 90 --fail-under-functions 90 on both matrix operating systems, so the gate is enforced outside the capture run as well. It writes the exclusion as LLVM_COV_FLAGS='-ignore-filename-regex=(^|[\\/])src[\\/]((main|lib)\.rs|ui[\\/])' because llvm-cov emits backslash-separated paths on Windows; the excluded set (src/main.rs, src/lib.rs, src/ui/**) and the 90 % threshold are identical to the capture configuration.

baseline.note: The 90% gate applies to core/ and platform/ pure logic, which measures 96.51% lines and 92.92% functions (unit_testable_scope.status = at_or_above_target) and is the metric range recorded against the 90% thresholds in openspec/changes/<change>/logs/evidence.json. The overall project percentage (87.75% lines, 84.25% functions) counts the display-bound files and is reported as a trend, not as a hard CI gate, until feature work begins (design D6): the Iced UI layer, the application loop and the binary edge cannot be unit-tested without a display server. The 90% threshold is never lowered; the excluded files are removed by the measurement configuration recorded under measurement_configuration.
baseline.sonarqube_gate_note: The SonarQube quality gate reports PASS because the gate conditions configured on the server carry no hard 90% coverage threshold during the bootstrap phase; coverage is a trend until feature work begins (design D6). The 90% target applies to the unit-testable scope recorded in unit_testable_scope (96.51% lines, 92.92% functions). sonar-project.properties declares analysis inputs only and holds no gate threshold, so the gate result is not evidence that the overall project percentage met the target. Rationale documented in docs/project-context.md.
